name: crenel-promo
description: Crenel promo video, built with Remotion.

scripts.render:mp4: npm run css && remotion render CrenelPromo out/crenel-promo.raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/crenel-promo.raw.mp4 -i music/soundtrack.mp3 -filter_complex "[1:a]afade=t=out:st=32.5:d=1.5,volume=0.9[a]" -map 0:v -map "[a]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/crenel-promo.mp4 && rm out/crenel-promo.raw.mp4
scripts.render:poster: npm run css && remotion still Poster out/poster.png
scripts.render:gif: remotion render CrenelPromo out/gif-src.mp4 --props='{"flat":true}' --scale=0.5 --crf=10 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/gif-src.mp4 -vf "fps=15,palettegen=max_colors=256:stats_mode=diff:reserve_transparent=0" out/palette.png && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/gif-src.mp4 -i out/palette.png -lavfi "fps=15[x];[x][1:v]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" out/crenel-promo.gif && rm out/palette.png out/gif-src.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:mp4 && npm run render:gif && npm run render:poster
